name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
description: Part of Bihar's Saat Nishchay programme providing education loans up to ₹4 lakh at nominal interest to students pursuing higher technical and professional studies.
descriptionHindi: 12वीं के बाद उच्च, तकनीकी एवं व्यावसायिक शिक्षा प्राप्त करने हेतु ₹4 लाख तक का रियायती शिक्षा ऋण।
benefits: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh with interest rate of 4% for male students and 1% for female, transgender, and differently-abled students, with moratorium until course completion.
benefitsHindi: छात्रों को 4% तथा छात्राओं व दिव्यांगों को मात्र 1% ब्याज दर पर ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण।
eligibilityText: Permanent residents of Bihar aged below 25 years who have passed Class 12 and gained admission in recognized higher education courses.
eligibilityTextHindi: 25 वर्ष से कम आयु के बिहार के निवासी जिन्होंने 12वीं उत्तीर्ण कर मान्यता प्राप्त कॉलेज में दाखिला लिया हो।
